maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from building and selling new homes (Trophy Signature, CB JENI townhomes), not repair or replacement work.

publicly_funded.reason: Buyers are private households purchasing new homes, funded by their own mortgages and savings, not by government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by developing land and selling homes through its seven builder brands, with only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Homebuyers choose among competing homebuilders on price and location; switching before purchase is easy.
